citations.assessment: The full Yerushalmi raises both a family relationship and the rule governing chaverim; Kahana’s example supplies the adjacent resolution. The digital witness has חתנהּ, and Penei Moshe reads him as Shmuel’s son-in-law. Heilprin’s separate Shmuel entry independently reports that relationship as an internal notice.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

evidence.reference: Penei Moshe on Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 1:2:7:7
